clue.en: Ancient Chera port linked to the Pattanam excavations

extraClue.en: Mentioned by Pliny; on the Periyar near today's Kodungallur

fact.en: Muziris was an ancient port on the Malabar coast that traded pepper with Rome. Excavations at Pattanam are linked to it.

clue.en: Northern Kerala region that was a district of the Madras Presidency

extraClue.en: It joined Kerala when the state was formed on 1 November 1956

fact.en: Malabar district was part of the Madras Presidency under British rule and became part of Kerala in 1956.

clue.en: 1924–25 satyagraha for the right to use temple roads

extraClue.en: Held in Travancore; Gandhiji visited in March 1925

fact.en: The Vaikom Satyagraha (1924–25) protested the ban on oppressed castes using the roads around the Vaikom temple.

extraClue.en: He reached the Malabar coast in 1498

fact.en: Vasco da Gama reached the Malabar coast near Kozhikode in May 1498, opening the sea route from Europe to India.

extraClue.en: One of the modern triumvirate of Malayalam poets

fact.en: Kumaran Asan wrote 'Veena Poovu' (1907) and is one of the modern triumvirate of Malayalam poetry with Ulloor and Vallathol.

clue.en: Beach near Kozhikode linked to Vasco da Gama's 1498 landing

extraClue.en: A memorial stone marks the spot

fact.en: Kappad beach near Kozhikode has a memorial marking Vasco da Gama's arrival in 1498.

clue.en: Initials of Kerala's first Chief Minister

extraClue.en: E. M. S. Namboodiripad, sworn in 1957

fact.en: E. M. S. Namboodiripad became Kerala's first Chief Minister in 1957.
